text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Ah, so cuuute!
I'll buy this sheet too☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Falco-san.
You've bought quite a lot of things.
What are you going to use all of that for?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They're aall materials for cheering fans!
My fave's release event is coming up soon, so I'm making a brand-new one for it☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, fans. Those fans with lettering written on them that you often see at Winning Lives?
Those were handmade, were they?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's right~! Pouring looots and lots of love for your fave with your very own hands☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hoho~...
...Falco-san. If you wouldn't mind, could you teach me how to make one, too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eh? Sure, but why so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My fans cheer for me with fans, too, you see. That's why I thought I'd like to try making one myself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, wonderful!
Then let's make them together right now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Breathe in, breathe out...
Like this, take the sheet...
...Geeeently, cut it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Geeeeeeently...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Takes a lot of focus, doesn't it~.
Once you do that, you layer multiple sheets together! That makes the lettering borders stand out☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. That's why they can be seen so clearly even from the stage, then.
I can really feel your thoughtful care toward your fave.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? Making them look pretty is tough.
But "Spare no effort for your fave!" is our motto☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see~. Well then, I suppose I should take my time and pour my feelings into it as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Geeeeently...
...Phew. That ought to do it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Is it already this late...?
Normally, I'd have been fast asleep in dreamland by now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone always goes through all this work for me, don't they... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Perhaps I'll continue the rest tomorrow.
...*yaaawn*~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Amaaaziing☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day. Dropping by the cafeteria, I heard Smart Falcon's lively voice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Acute-san made this!
The curves of the letters are so amazingly neat and pretty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You could tell at a single glance that it was crafted with immense time and care.
The layered cutout characters were all finished with flawless balance.
choice_data_list: It's like a work of art!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I love sewing, so meticulous little tasks are my forte, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I had no idea it took so much effort.
To think all the fans do this every single time...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: When I thought about that... I felt fired up, knowing I have to work even harder than before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because now I know how much trouble they go through to cheer me on.
That means they have that much expectation for my running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to live up to everyone's feelings... no, show them a run that exceeds them.
That's why my hands just wouldn't stop moving.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And so... I didn't stop at just one; I made two more. Tarumae-chan and Rickey-chan's faces popped into my mind along the way, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All three of them are precious people who give me just as much inspiration as the fans do.
It took time, but I wanted to put my gratitude into form.
choice_data_list: Let's definitely use them at the live!
Your endurance for steady, tedious work is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd love to wave them a whole bunch at Falco-san's upcoming "live"~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Falco's so happy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for coming! Falco is so moved by all the handmade fans!
Let's get hyped up today too☆

text_block_list.name: Acute & Others
text_block_list.text:
L-O-V-E!
LOVE-kyun Falcooo!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. Falco-san, Tarumae-chan, and the others all seem to be having fun.
Pouring my heart into making them was truly worthwhile.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, bit by bit...
Slowly stacking up effort suits my nature best, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Not just with hobbies, but in races too.
I want to keep running solidly for a long, long time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... you're right!
The road to becoming the top Umadol is one step at a time, too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a super steep path.
As long as you don't give up, dreams will come true!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter how much time it takes.
The important thing is to never stop your legs.
